ITEM.PTXT: A 2-way intake system that switches the intake passage in 2 stages according to the driving conditions has been adopted to achieve both high performance and low noise.
A 2-way intake valve is located in the air cleaner case, and the shape allows a large volume of intake air to flow, reducing intake resistance.
During normal driving, air is drawn only through the cool air intake, and in the high-speed, high-load range, air is drawn through both the cool air intake and the 2-way intake valve.

ENTRY.PTXT: Detects the throttle valve opening angle.
Mounted on the air cleaner case, it opens and closes using vacuum from the 2-way intake VSV.
Switches the vacuum to the 2-way intake valve; when vacuum is sent to the diaphragm, the 2-way intake valve opens.
Mounted on the air cleaner cap, it stores the vacuum needed in the medium speed range under high load.
Mounted on the air cleaner case, it opens and closes the 2-way intake valve using vacuum from the 2-way intake VSV.
Sends a signal to the 2-way intake VSV at the appropriate timing based on the signals from the crank position sensor and throttle position sensor.
